landing.title: CVs that look right in Hebrew and English
landing.subtitle: Write your CV once, switch templates instantly, and export a PDF where mixed Hebrew and English text, emails, phone numbers and dates stay in the right order.
landing.localFirst: Everything stays in your browser. No account needed.
landing.f1Body: Templates mirror correctly, and tokens like C++, GD&T or 05/2025 never get scrambled.
landing.f2Body: Edit on one side and see real pages on the other, exactly as they print.
landing.f3Body: Military service, Hebrew section titles and Israeli phone formats out of the box.
landing.f4Body: Stored locally in your browser, with full JSON backup and restore.
landing.templatesSubtitle: Ten original designs, each tested in Hebrew and English.

dashboard.title: My documents
dashboard.emptyBody: Create your first CV from scratch, from the sample, or import a JSON file.
dashboard.emptyLettersBody: Cover letters arrive in phase 6. They will share the theme and header of a linked CV.
dashboard.trackerBody: A kanban board for saved, applied, interview, offer and rejected applications arrives in phase 6.

deleteDialog.body: This removes the document and its version history from this browser. It cannot be undone. Consider downloading a JSON backup first.
